items.title: Pay utility cost balance (2024/25)
items.quote: Please settle the outstanding balance of €184.20 no later than 30 days after the date of this statement.
items.computation: This is a private-law payment deadline (landlord to tenant), counted under §§ 187, 188 BGB. The event triggering the period is the date of the statement, 3 November 2025; that day is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Counting 30 days forward: day 1 = 4 Nov, ..., day 27 = 30 Nov, day 28 = 1 Dec, day 29 = 2 Dec, day 30 = 3 Dec 2025. So the period ends 3 December 2025, which is a Wednesday (not a weekend or public holiday in NRW or Berlin), so no shift under § 193 BGB is needed.
